name: What is involved in a ground-up construction project for a home?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a ground-up construction project for a home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ground-up construction involves building a new residential structure from the foundation upwards on a vacant piece of land. This comprehensive process includes site preparation, foundation pouring, framing, roofing, installing all utilities and systems (electrical, plumbing, HVAC), and completing interior and exterior finishes. AKN Design Group approaches ground-up construction with an integrated design-build methodology, ensuring a single point of coordination for the entire project, from initial concept and architectural planning to the final landscaping and interior details, harmonizing design vision with construction execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ground-up construction builds a new home from the foundation up, encompassing site work, structural build, systems installation, and finishes. AKN Design Group integrates design and construction for a cohesive project.
